description: This is a Java test class for the Calculator component, containing unit tests for calculator operations such as addition, handling fractions, and squaring a number. It uses JUnit framework for testing and references the Operations class for resetting state.

classes.name: CalculatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Calculator functionalities, including addition, repeated operations, fractional input, and squaring.

classes.name: TestTextProvider
classes.description: A private static inner class implementing TextProvider, used as a mock to verify display output during tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the calculator state after each test by calling Operations.INSTANCE.reset().

methods.name: testPlus
methods.description: Tests simple addition of 1 + 2 and verifies the display shows 3.0.

methods.name: testTwoTimesPlus
methods.description: Tests sequential addition: 1 + 2 + 3, expecting the result 6.0.

methods.name: testPlusWithFraction
methods.description: Tests addition with fractional input: 1 + 2.1, expecting 3.1.
